headline: United's hubs are running normally; a ground stop holds flights into LaGuardia.

items.text: United's hubs are running normally: the seven reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better. No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any hub, and weather is not affecting operations at any of the 9 hubs with a current report.
The FAA has a ground stop in effect for flights into New York LaGuardia until 9:15 PM ET because of an equipment outage. Those flights are held at their departure airport.

The FAA's operations plan lists 4 possible or planned programs for later, and none is in effect now: a possible ground stop or ground delay program for flights into Boston after tomorrow 1:00 PM ET, a possible ground stop for Miami after tomorrow 1:00 PM ET, and possible programs for San Diego after tomorrow 9:00 AM PT and Seattle after tomorrow 6:00 AM PT.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to New York LaGuardia, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
